column1: # A first rich Amharic deck, curated from decks/harvest-2026-10-25.tsv and the group's
# own playlist on 25 October 2026. The years were proposals then: Deezer's dates where
# they looked original, the Ethiopiques spans for the golden era, and marked guesses.
# On 26 October 2026 every year was checked against the sources its note names: the
# Ethiopiques booklets as transcribed on Discogs, the original Amha, Kaifa and Philips
# 45s and LPs on Discogs, the African Cassettes archive at Mainz University, Wikipedia
# and artist discographies, and for recent songs the official video's upload date set
# beside Deezer's own date. A note that starts with "confirmed" imports its row as
# confirmed; every other note says what is still missing, and "was 1970" records the
# year it replaced. Deezer track ids are given wherever the deck has one, so the import
# only asks Deezer about the eleven songs that play from YouTube.
# year <TAB> artist_latin <TAB> title_latin <TAB> artist_am <TAB> title_am <TAB> youtube_url <TAB> deezer_track_id <TAB> # note
